Extract mean bootstrap weights with CI/frequency filtering

Source: R/mbspls_extract_bootstrap_means.R
mbspls_extract_bootstrap_means.Rd

Reads the bootstrap summaries stored by PipeOpMBsPLSBootstrapSelect: weights_ci (means and percentile intervals of the replicate weights, already matched to the training components, sign-aligned block by block and filtered by the min_score_cor acceptance gate) and weights_selectfreq. Nothing is re-aligned here.

mbspls_extract_bootstrap_means(
  model,
  component = 1,
  filter_method = c("ci", "frequency"),
  filter_level = NULL
)

Arguments

model

A trained mlr3pipelines::GraphLearner or mlr3pipelines::Graph containing a PipeOpMBsPLSBootstrapSelect node, the trained PipeOp itself, its state (e.g. glearner$model$mbspls_bootstrap_select), or a list holding that state under mbspls_bootstrap_select.

component

Integer LC index (e.g., 1).

filter_method

One of c("ci","frequency").

  • "ci": keep features whose interval is strictly above or below zero and whose |mean| exceeds the selector's magnitude_threshold (default 1e-3).

  • "frequency": keep features with selection freq >= filter_level.

filter_level

Numeric threshold:

  • if filter_method == "ci": confidence level in (0,1). Stored summaries are available only at the level used for training, 1 - alpha, which is the default; another level is an error (retrain with a different alpha). States that do not record alpha have intervals of unknown level: filter_level is then ignored with a warning.

  • if filter_method == "frequency": minimum freq in [0,1], default the selector's frequency_threshold (0.5 if it is not stored).

Value

A data.table with columns component, block, feature, mean, ci_low, ci_high and freq (NA if frequencies are unavailable) for the features that pass the filter, sorted by block and decreasing |mean|.

Details

For legacy inputs that only provide per-replicate draws in weights_boot_draws (columns component, block, feature, replicate, weight), the draws must already be sign-aligned; they are summarised with type-7 percentile intervals.
